title: PocketHost
description: A mobile platform that lets users host dedicated Minecraft servers directly from Android devices without port forwarding or desktop hardware.
challenge: Minecraft server hosting is typically tied to desktop hardware, manual Java setup, and router port forwarding, making self-hosting difficult on Android devices and cellular networks.
solution: Built a native Android app with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose that launches bundled ARM64 OpenJDK runtimes through a JNI launcher, paired with a Node.js TCP/UDP relay network for zero-configuration connectivity and Geyser integration for Bedrock cross-play.
results: Enabled dedicated Minecraft server hosting directly on Android devices
Eliminated the need for router port forwarding through a relay network
Integrated Bedrock cross-play support with Geyser
Delivered a mobile-first hosting experience with a native Android interface
